gen-dafont-ethnocentric-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab stands tall and grounded, every lowercase letter built with height. Ethnocentric is best at speed and bite, its wide-set letters pushing apart, while the body font is best at steady, refined reading.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-fs-erode: Erode has a tall middle band with shallow ascenders, and its stroke weight ebbs and flows gently under Ethnocentric. Long paragraphs would move along smoothly, dignified and quite unhurried.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-fs-hoover: Refined and robust, Hoover gives the e's eye a generous entry and keeps its ascenders compressed beneath Ethnocentric. Page after page would feel sturdy, smooth and quietly well finished.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-fs-trench-slab: Ethnocentric is fast and aggressive, with short ascenders over big bowls and letters pushed well apart. But Trench Slab stays dignified and refined, its lowercase rising almost to the height of the capitals.
gen-dafont-galaxy-fs-bespoke-slab: Uninterrupted line width runs through every Galaxy letter, loose and cosmic with plenty of space around them. And if Bespoke Slab were made large, its tall lowercase would start competing with the heading.
gen-dafont-galaxy-fs-erode: Dignified Erode lets its stroke widths shift just enough to notice, while Galaxy keeps no hairline-to-stem change at all. Galaxy is best at cosmic command, Erode at editorial reading.
gen-dafont-galaxy-fs-hoover: Cosmic and commanding, Galaxy runs a tube-like, constant-width stroke, while Hoover keeps low contrast and compressed ascenders. Galaxy is best at sheer presence, Hoover at refined, robust text setting.
gen-dafont-good-times-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab is grounded and refined, with tall bodies in every lowercase letter. Good Times is best at geometric command, its thick small letters like bundled cable, while the serif handles the reading.
gen-dafont-good-times-fs-trench-slab: Good Times is commanding and geometric, with an open e and only mild variation between heavy and light parts. Trench Slab stands out for its dignified, refined lowercase that rises nearly to cap height.
gen-dafont-groovy-fs-bespoke-slab: Friendly and funky, Groovy loosely tracks its lowercase and keeps a smooth drawn-wire feel across the whole line. Bespoke Slab supplies the grounding, tall lowercase bodies that make the pairing feel anchored.
